items.text:
You asked: I have a Medicare Supplement. Can I still change my drug plan this fall? Yes. Through Dec 7 you can switch Part D drug plans, and the new plan starts Jan 1. Your Supplement stays as it is. Drug lists and pharmacy networks can change each year, so compare plans against the medications you take now. Bring your list and we can compare with you. Licensed in VA, MD, GA, TX, MI, NC, SC, AL, LA, IN and WV. Call (571) 354-0146.

We do not offer every plan available in your area. Any information we provide is limited to those plans we do offer in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
